description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach class, which manages the runtime behavior of foreach loops within the Smarty template engine, including initialization, counting, and restoring loop variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach
classes.description: Handles the runtime management of foreach loops in Smarty templates, including setup, counting elements, and restoring scope.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the foreach loop, saving variables, setting up loop counters, and handling special properties like total and iteration counts.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts elements in arrays, objects implementing traversable or countable interfaces, PDOStatement objects, or general iterables.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores previously saved variable states after loop iterations conclude or are interrupted.
